mapper.select: SELECT record.sign_status, record.measure_type, record.quantity, record.storage_material_no as storageMaterialNo, record.storage_material_batch_no as materialBatchNo, record.storage_material_batch_id, record.unit_id, record.measurer_id, record.re_checker_id, record.measure_time, record.container_name, record.material_position as positionName, record.formula_material_id, material.material_name as materialName, material.material_merge_code as materialMergeCode, material.material_specification as specification, material.material_type FROM bm_liquid_preparation_measure_record record LEFT JOIN bm_product_formula_material material ON material.id = record.formula_material_id WHERE record.measure_instance_id = #{measureInstanceId}
